title: BEACON Adapter Registry / Manifest
description: Validates the adapter registry manifest (adapter-contract.md §5 'Registry / manifest format'; SPEC §4.2; FR-10/OP2/OP3). The composition root (src/main) builds the registry from this manifest and VALIDATES IT AGAINST THIS SCHEMA AT BOOT — fail-fast (F10/U5): every module must export a SourceAdapterPort, every port must be a known port id, every config prefix must resolve required keys/URLs for its mode. Adding a source = add one manifest entry + an adapter file; zero core change. Field set is canonical per adapter-contract §5 (tagged-object Coverage, LIVE|CACHED|MOCK mode, circuitBreaker/cache/mock blocks, license).

$schemaVersion.description: Manifest schema version (adapter-contract §5, e.g. '1.0'). Optional; lets the registry detect manifest-format drift at boot.

adapters.description: The registered source adapters. Each entry maps 1:1 to a SourceAdapterPort implementation and to a SOURCE_RECORD.adapter id.

mode.description: Redundancy-ladder mode (CONFIGURATION §6/§11; SOURCE_<NAME>_MODE). LIVE = upstream; CACHED = last-known-good; MOCK = recorded fixture.

coverage.description: Where this adapter has data (adapter-contract §3 Coverage; drives OP4 'not available in this region'). A tagged object discriminated by 'kind'.

iso.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country codes this adapter covers.

id.description: Stable adapter id == SourceAdapterPort.id == SourceRecord.adapter (e.g. 'osm-overpass'). kebab-case.

port.description: Which port interface this adapter implements (e.g. 'Infrastructure', 'HazardSource', 'FloodGauge'). The registry rejects unknown port ids at boot.

entity.description: Optional canonical entity this adapter produces (e.g. 'InfrastructureNode').

module.description: Dynamic import path of the adapter implementation (e.g. '@/adapters/osm-overpass-adapter'). Must export a SourceAdapterPort (boot check).

intervalSec.description: Poll cadence in seconds (SOURCE_<NAME>_INTERVAL_SEC override; adapter-contract §5 intervalSecOverride).

configPrefix.description: Env prefix the adapter reads (e.g. 'OVERPASS' -> SOURCE_OVERPASS_MODE / _INTERVAL_SEC / endpoint). The registry checks required keys/URLs resolve for the active mode.

license.description: Data license -> SourceRecord.license, tracked in NOTICE (Art. XI), e.g. 'ODbL', 'Public Domain (US Gov)'.

attribution.description: Optional required attribution string (e.g. '© OpenStreetMap contributors').

ttlSec.description: Cache TTL in seconds (CACHE_TTL_SEC analog; default 900).

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures before the breaker trips OPEN.

cooldownSec.description: Seconds the breaker stays OPEN (short-circuit to cache/mock) before HALF_OPEN.

halfOpenTrials.description: Trial calls allowed through in HALF_OPEN before re-closing/re-opening.

mock.description: Recorded-mock fallback block (adapter-contract §3.1; OP3). Enables the air-gapped acceptance test (F5).

gaugeUnit.description: FloodGauge adapters only (ADR-012 — config, not code): the unit this source publishes its Gauge.stage / Gauge.crestForecast figures in, VERBATIM (e.g. 'ft', 'm³/s'). The canonical Gauge entity carries plain numbers and no unit, and the unit differs per source, so this row is what lets a SERVED gauge reading be surfaced as a labeled figure in the SitRep's crest fact (Art. XII). An adapter with no gaugeUnit has its numeric readings OMITTED from the fact rather than printed bare or guessed — mis-stating feet as metres on a river is worse than omitting the number. Per-ADAPTER, never per-region: adding a zone never touches this.
